additional_info.subject: RE: ID0439763-DC/Si-D/NL-[MP / RN 170002828] Charger not come online OCPP connection. CRM:02682000222
additional_info.body:
Dear Ankita,
Here is the information (IN RED) you will need to configure the backend.
OCPP Central System URL
ws://connect.longship.io/790c9ccdb4a0255d06224899767c0cf2/NL-ENV-00002
or ws://connect.longship.io/790c9ccdb4a0255d06224899767c0cf2/ (without the charge-point ID behind the URL)
Authorization key of the charger for OCPP backend
None / not used
Unique OCPP Charge-Point ID (as defined by the OCPP backend)
NL-ENV-00002
I don’t know if you need it, but this can also help:
Socket ID #1 (LEFT) = NL-ENV-00002-01
Socket ID #2 (RIGHT) = NL-ENV-00002-02
SIM APN: m2m.tele2.com
(automatic should also work)
You can also copy the settings from the other charger, that’s already online in the backend. Main Asset: MP / RN 170002828 ChargerID/Serial No.: vGCZ2F
Kind regards,

Dear Jeroen de Jong,
Regarding your queries:
1.Yes, we can update the charger firmware.
2.Maximum Capacity Setting: Yes, it is possible to configure the charger to a maximum output of 140 kW, considering your grid connection limit of 225 Amps.
This can be set via the charger's configuration interface or backend system.
Kindly create a separate ticket for this request.
